about: What x402scan reads and verifies as ownership proofs, taken from its source (Merit-Systems/x402scan at 5732bb83c8c4290f413f24318a838e3fee4ed2bf, and @agentcash/discovery 1.7.5, which it pins to read the OpenAPI document). The vectors were signed by unfret.x402.wallet.HotWallet.ownership_proof and verified with x402scan's own verifyAnyOwnershipProof (apps/scan/src/lib/ownership-proof.ts) under Node.

solana.scheme: ed25519 over the origin's UTF-8 bytes (nacl.sign.detached.verify), signature base58 (hex is a fallback)

evm.scheme: EIP-191 personal_sign of the origin (viem recoverMessageAddress), 0x-prefixed hex; the recovered address must equal payTo
evm.note: Signed by unfret.x402.evm_wallet.BaseHotWallet.ownership_proof with a test key of 32 bytes of 0x11 (never funded, never used); checked against EIP-191 itself (keccak-256 of "\x19Ethereum Signed Message:\n" + the origin's length + the origin, then ECDSA recovery), which is what viem's recoverMessageAddress computes. Not run through x402scan's own code.
